extraction.notes: No summer 2027 or 2026 camp information could be verified. Direct access to the official website and event pages was blocked by robots.txt; official search-indexed text was available. Historical Vacation Bible School and Camp Connect listings were found at https://trinitywavl.org/event/vacation-bible-school/, https://trinitywavl.org/event/vacation-bible-school-0/, https://trinitywavl.org/event/camp-connect/ and https://trinitywavl.org/event/camp-connect-0/. The latter Camp Connect listing dates to 2016, and a 2022 newsletter also mentions VBS. These historical offerings were not turned into 2026 or 2027 cards because current operation and year-specific details could not be established. Contact the church to confirm whether either program will return in 2027.
